usageNotes: Returns the top-level ACME index listing available child resources (accounts, directories, plugins, TOS). Use this as a discovery call to confirm ACME support is accessible before navigating to sub-resources. No parameters are required and all authenticated users can call it.

examples.summary: List ACME index resources on the cluster

tips: The returned array contains child resource names (e.g. 'accounts', 'directories', 'plugins', 'tos') — use these as the next path segment to drill into specific ACME configuration.
This endpoint is a directory index, not a list of ACME accounts; use get_cluster_acme_accounts to enumerate configured accounts.
API tokens are allowed, so this can be called from automation without a full user session.
